queue.contract: Add ?projection=roster returning {id,name,rollNumber,parentLanguage,hasParentPhone,parentPhoneLast4}. getStudents() currently returns the whole document including parentPhone in E.164, while the Flutter domain model states 'the client never holds the full parent phone number'. Wiring the roster before this ships would put every parent's number on every teacher's handset. Default response stays byte-identical so the web student-manager is untouched.
notes: This is the true head of Band B2. Starting the Flutter roster first means writing a DTO against a shape we intend to change, and shipping a PII leak in the meantime.

queue.title: Attendance domain, DTOs and repository (no UI)
queue.contract: A new lib/features/attendance data+domain layer against the ten REST routes that already ship on origin/main. Correct the stale forensic claim that attendance is backend-blocked in the same commit, or the next agent re-derives the same wrong conclusion.

queue.title: Attendance: class list, class CRUD, route, premium-gate panel
queue.contract: Reads are ungated; every WRITE is premium-gated server-side (requireProPlan covers createClass, addStudent and saveAttendance), so a free-plan teacher gets a read-only register and a 403 the moment they mark it. The UI must say so before the tap, not after.

blockedBy.detail: H6 — a pro/advanced-plan test account. Without one only the 403 path is provable; the happy path is not.

queue.title: Attendance: student roster and CRUD
queue.contract: 40-student cap (enforced transactionally server-side), roll numbers 1-40, E.164 phone validation. Consumes the masked projection from U2.1.

queue.title: Attendance: mark the register
queue.contract: The server clamps date to [today-7d, today] computed in Asia/Kolkata. A client computing 'today' in device-local time returns 400 for any teacher marking between 00:00 and 05:30 IST. Compute the window in IST and CLAMP the date picker rather than validating after the fact — a teacher must not be offered a date the server will reject. Unit-test with a fixed clock at 20:00 UTC, where the naive implementation picks the wrong day.

queue.title: Attendance: monthly view, summaries, per-student absences
queue.contract: Monthly grid plus summaries and the per-student absence list, all from existing routes.

queue.title: Parent Hotline: bring the roster to life
queue.contract: hotline_roster_provider.dart returns const <HotlineStudent>[] unconditionally — the one dead wire in an otherwise complete 13-file feature with four stage widgets and a full typed exception hierarchy already built. Replace it with the real provider and move the screen from List to AsyncValue (loading skeleton / ErrorView / signed-out EmptyView). Budget this small and be pleased if it is smaller.

queue.title: Parent Hotline: error-path audit and resume-on-open
queue.contract: An AUDIT unit, not a build unit: confirm each typed exception (403 PREMIUM_REQUIRED, 429 with Retry-After, 422 no phone, 503 Twilio unconfigured, 403 not-your-class) reaches a distinct, dignified panel, and fill only what is missing. Verify resume-on-open via outreach-latest with its 24h lookback.

queue.title: Result actions: Copy, Share, Save-to-Library — pilot on two screens
queue.contract: A shared ResultActionsBar reusing share_plus, path_provider and library_repository.dart, all already in the tree. Eleven of thirteen tool results currently dead-end at copy-to-clipboard. Note /api/content/save requires a client-generated UUID v4: generate from Random.secure() rather than adding a package for twenty lines.

queue.title: Result actions: roll out to the remaining eleven result views
queue.contract: Same bar, eleven more screens.

queue.title: PDF export: an Indic-shaping spike, gated on a human look
queue.contract: A SPIKE, not a rollout. The Dart pdf package does no complex-script shaping: Devanagari conjuncts, Tamil ligatures and Odia render as boxes or reorder. Render one line of each of the 11 scripts, produce a golden PNG, and put it in front of the founder before any rollout. A Hindi worksheet rendered as boxes is worse than the clipboard. If shaping fails, the honest ship is Share-as-text and PDF is flagged as needing a server-side renderer.

blockedBy.detail: Founder reviews the 11-script golden PNG before any rollout decision.

queue.title: Notifications surface
queue.contract: The Network hub already reserves a third tab, and /api/notifications, /mark-read and /mark-all-read all exist. Push (FCM) is the payoff but is human-blocked on Firebase console registration; it lands as its own single-purpose unit, because this repo has already lost a build to a federated plugin.

queue.title: Landing: final release gate, generated report, draft PR, checkpoint
queue.contract: Full release ladder on HEAD. Record the AAB (path, bytes, sha256, signer cert, match). doc_truth_guard --strict green, or the offending doc is edited to the truth. SESSION_REPORT.md is GENERATED from WAKE_LOG.jsonl by script, never hand-written, so a wake that shipped nothing appears as a wake that shipped nothing. Push, open a DRAFT PR to main, run /checkpoint, then ScheduleWakeup stop.
